chamada: What protects your account and what to do if a device falls into the wrong hands.

panico.texto: Signs your account out of every device, this one included, and erases what the site and Alumia stored on this device: drafts, chat keys, saved pages. Then it opens an ordinary page from elsewhere.
panico.esconder: Also hide my profile until I come back
panico.esconderAjuda: It disappears from search, suggestions, mentions and the profile page. When you come back, you can show it again here.
panico.atalhoTexto: With the shortcut on, pressing Esc three times in a row leaves this device at once, on any screen. It lasts until you close this tab.

escondido.texto: Hidden by the panic button on {quando}. Nobody can find your profile while it stays like this.

fator.ligado: On. A password alone does not open your account.
fator.desligado: No authenticator app on this account.
fator.desligadoTexto: On Alumia, the 6-digit code is asked at every sign-in. Set up the app when the sign-in asks for it.
fator.alertaTexto: Every time your account signs in on a device, an alert arrives here on Alumia and in your email, with the browser, the system, the day and the time. If it was not you, sign the devices out.

codigos.texto: Ten single-use codes to get in if you lose the phone with the app. Using a code removes the app from the account: you set up another right away, and the other devices are signed out.
codigos.nenhum: You do not have recovery codes yet.
codigos.deNovoAviso: The codes you have today will stop working.
codigos.confirmarGerar: Create and cancel the old ones
codigos.mostrarTexto: They are shown only once. Download or copy them and keep them away from your phone: paper in a drawer or a password manager.
codigos.precisaFator: The codes depend on the authenticator app. Set up the app first.

instrucoes: Use one if you lose the phone with the authenticator app.

aparelhos.texto: Where your account is open now: the browser, the system and the days. The network address does not appear anywhere.
aparelhos.semCodigo: Signed in without the app code
aparelhos.confirmarOutros: Sign out the other devices? They will need to sign in again, with password and code.
aparelhos.indisponivel: The device list is not available right now.

busca.texto: You disappear from people search, @ suggestions and who-to-follow lists. Anyone who already has your full @ can still find your profile.

tor.texto: With Tor Browser, Alumia's chat opens without our server or anyone on your network knowing where you connect from. It has its own .onion address.
tor.semEndereco: The chat's .onion address has not been published yet.
tor.comoUsar: Open the address in Tor Browser (torproject.org) and chat by text.
tor.comoFunciona: How the .onion service is set up (in the open source code)

recuperar.link: I lost the phone with the app
recuperar.titulo: Sign in with a recovery code
recuperar.texto: Type one of the ten codes you saved. The authenticator app leaves the account and you set up another right after; the other devices are signed out.
recuperar.certo: Code accepted. Now set up the authenticator app again.

erros.confirme: Confirm the authenticator app code in this session and try again.
erros.falha: That did not work now. Try again in a moment.
erros.muitos: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.

isca.texto: A second password, for this device only. If someone forces you to open Alumia, type the panic password instead of yours: the device signs in to a decoy account with a neutral profile and removes your account from here, the way Quick exit does. The sign-in screen is the same either way.
isca.servidor: Nothing is deleted on the server. It is a personal safety tool against someone forcing access to your device: Alumia complies with the law and valid court orders using the real data.
isca.ativarTroca: If this device already has a panic password, the new one takes its place. To prepare or turn off the one that exists, use Prepare the decoy account.
isca.senhaAjuda: Different from your sign-in password and easy to remember under pressure. At least 8 characters.
isca.realAjuda: Only to check that the two are different. It does not leave this device and is not stored.
isca.emailAjuda: An email of yours that is not this account's (an email alias works). It receives the confirmation link.
isca.codinomeAjuda: An ordinary code name that does not resemble yours.
isca.criada: Decoy account created, and its vault is stored, encrypted, on this device. Next, confirm the decoy's email.
isca.ativaTexto: The vault with the decoy account stays encrypted in this browser, and the panic password works only here. On another device, it has to be turned on there.
isca.prepararTexto: Type the panic password to open the decoy here, without leaving your account, and see what it still needs.
isca.desativarTexto: Deletes the decoy's vault from this device. The decoy account still exists: to delete it, sign in to it and use the normal account deletion.
isca.desativada: Panic password turned off on this device.

confirmar_email.texto: Open the link sent to the decoy account's email in a private window or on another device: opened in this browser, it swaps your account for the decoy. Then come back here.

sem_pedido.texto: The decoy goes through screening like any account. Write an ordinary reason, with nothing that links the decoy to you.

em_analise.texto: The decoy's request is waiting for screening. Come back after the answer.

recusada.titulo: Screening did not approve the decoy
recusada.texto: Turn off the panic password and create another decoy with another email.

suspensa.texto: Turn off the panic password and create another decoy with another email.

cadastrar_fator.texto: On Alumia every account asks for the app code, the decoy too. Add the decoy to your authenticator app under a name that draws no attention. When you sign in with the panic password, the code asked is the decoy's.

pedir_codigo.texto: Type the decoy's code from your authenticator app to finish preparing it.

povoar.texto: The decoy finishes its first visit without choices and can follow a pack of public profiles, so it does not look empty. It posts nothing.

pronta.texto: At sign-in, the panic password instead of yours opens the decoy and removes your account from this device. The code asked next is the decoy's.

isca.motivo: Why do you want to join
isca.aceite: I have read and accept Alumia's terms and rules
isca.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
isca.segredo: Or type this secret in the app:

erros.curta: The panic password needs at least 8 characters.
erros.diferentes: The two panic passwords do not match.
erros.igual: The panic password cannot be the same as your sign-in password.
erros.semReal: Type your sign-in password, to check that it is a different one.
erros.emailIgual: Use an email different from this account's.
erros.codinome: The code name needs 3 to 30 characters, with no @ or address.
erros.motivo: Write the reason in 10 to 500 characters, with no email or phone.
erros.idade: Confirm that the decoy belongs to someone 18 or older.
erros.aceite: Accept the terms and the rules.
erros.errada: That is not this device's panic password.
erros.semArmazenamento: This browser did not let the vault be stored. Outside a private window, try again.
erros.cadastroFechado: Sign-up is closed right now. Try later.
erros.muitos: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
erros.codigo: Wrong code. Check the app and try again.
erros.falha: It did not work right now. Try again in a moment.
